thread.title: Amazon Closes at $1,500 for First Time

author: Jon Swartz
title: Amazon Closes at $1,500 for First Time
text:
(Photo by David Ryder/Getty Images) Illustration: David Ryder/Getty Images Shares of Amazon.com (AMZN) closed at $1,500 for the first time ever today, propelling the company's market value to $726.2 billion, behind only Apple (AAPL) and Alphabet (GOOGL).
The third time proved to be the charm. Amazon briefly topped 1,500 in intraday trading the previous two days before settling below the magic mark.
Amazon's stock, which has soared 28% this year, have been on a tear after it reported a $1.86 billion profit in its December quarter.
The Seattle-based company has also benefited from aggressive expansion into the grocery industry with its $13 billion acquisition of Whole Foods Market , and a proposed partnership in health care with Warren Buffett and Jaime Dimon . It is expected this year to announce the winning city in its search for a $5 billion second headquarters .
